study_identification_part.si_3_author_journal_year: Fraza et al., Nature Mental Health, 2024
study_identification_part.si_4_title: Unraveling the link between CNVs, cognition and individual neuroimaging deviation scores from a population-based reference cohort

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Normative modeling was performed using Warped Bayesian Linear Regression (WBLR) with B-spline basis functions and Sin-arcsinh likelihood warping to account for non-linearity and non-Gaussianity.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text:
We employed the Bayesian linear regression function from the PCNtoolkit to create the normative models for each voxel... To ensure accurate modeling of nonlinear and non-Gaussian effects, we employed a B-spline basis function and likelihood warping, as described in ref. 38.
... utilizing the warped BLR algorithm from PCNtoolkit.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.location: Fraza2023.pdf.md: Methods / Normative modeling with Bayesian linear regression; Fraza2023_sup1.pdf.md: Methods / Normative model formulation

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: The study utilized two types of data: 1) A set of Image-Derived Phenotypes (IDPs) from UK Biobank including structural (CT, SA, Volumes), diffusion (FA, MD, MO, OD, ICVF, ISOVF/FW), and functional (connectivity) measures. 2) A voxel-wise normative model using Jacobian determinants (Deformation-Derived Morphometry) from T1-weighted images to map local volume expansion/contraction.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text:
We employed the Bayesian linear regression function from the PCNtoolkit to create the normative models for each voxel... To ensure accurate modeling of nonlinear and non-Gaussian effects, we employed a B-spline basis function and likelihood warping, as described in ref. 38.
... utilizing the warped BLR algorithm from PCNtoolkit.
nm2_2_response_variable.location: Fraza2023.pdf.md: Methods / Normative modeling with Bayesian linear regression; Fraza2023_sup1.pdf.md: Methods / Normative model formulation

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: The normative models included Age and Sex as covariates, and Site was included as a fixed effect to account for site differences.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text:
Every normative model constructed factored in the covariates age and sex. To reduce site effects, we have added it as a fixed effect in the model.
... Covariates encompassed age, binary sex, and binary site ID within the covariance matrix.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.location: Fraza2023.pdf.md: Methods / Normative modeling with Bayesian linear regression; Fraza2023_sup1.pdf.md: Methods / Normative model formulation
